summary.action_items:
**Jon Simon**
Prepare three flat-rate pricing options (small, medium, large) for fractional operational leadership covering time estimates and scope (11:01)
Compile a checklist/framework of operational divisions and roles to share with client and use as a discussion tool for coverage and readiness (07:41)
Work with Andrew to figure out how to structure and price retainer for ongoing operational support beyond sale process (09:43)
Assist in planning and potentially delivering a 3-6 month pre-sale operational readiness service including documentation and financial presentation prep (17:52)

**Andrew Day**
Communicate to client (buyer and seller) the proposal for part-time continuation of current ops person to maintain continuity and stabilize org chart (09:43)
Develop pricing strategy overlay above Jon’s operational pricing to make continued client acquisition and delivery financially viable (07:09)
Coordinate and lead sell-side process, ensuring quick market prep and exploring integration with new pre-sale operational readiness product (16:16)
Engage with Jon on further sales meeting and alignment with buyers (19:11)
summary.overview:
- **Ops Lead Transition:** Quickly fill the ops lead gap to ensure business continuity during the sale process. 

- **Partial Support Plan:** Retain outgoing ops lead part-time for smoother transition and stability before the sale.

- **Pricing Model:** Offer flat-rate pricing between $10,000 and $15,000 with three engagement tiers for operational support.

- **Pre-Sale Engagement:** Implement a 3-6 month pre-sale service to enhance business value and prepare necessary documentation.

- **Operational Framework:** Develop a detailed checklist to identify gaps, ensuring aligned support tailored to client needs.

- **Ongoing Communication:** Adjust operational support based on sale status and maintain employee relations during transition.
summary.short_summary: The meeting centered on navigating the departure of the operations lead, with Jon Simon confirming the urgent need for a fractional replacement to ensure business continuity amid the pending sale. Jon volunteered to manage the client’s team of 7-8 employees, dedicating 20-30 hours monthly while the outgoing ops lead remains part-time to facilitate a smooth transition and retain stability for potential buyers. A flat-rate pricing model was proposed, ranging from $10,000 to $15,000, with three engagement tiers aimed at operational support. Additionally, a structured 3-6 month pre-sale readiness service was discussed to enhance business value, focusing on documentation and organizational preparedness. Jon is developing a framework to assess operational gaps and tailor support as needed, emphasizing ongoing communication to adjust to changes in the sale timeline.
